Q9029.reason: Water is hypotonic and can be absorbed through the bladder wall, causing electrolyte disturbance such as hyponatraemia, so sterile saline is used instead.

Q9030.reason: The son is an intended third-party beneficiary, but the modification came before his rights vested through knowledge or reliance, so C is a strong rival.

Q9031.reason: Under UCC 2-210 and 9-406, a general prohibition on assignment doesn't bar assignment of the right to receive payment unless it specifically says so.
